name: 林懷恩
objective:
先修課程：負責教授同意。精密量測學概論、長度量測、角度量測、幾何誤差量測（含直線度、平行度、垂直度、真圓度、平面度）、溫度量測、力、力矩和應變量測、加速度、速度量測、齒輪檢測儀、三次元座標量測、工具機檢測。
Metrology Introduction, distance measurements, angular measurements, measurement of geometrical tolerance (straightness, parallelism, squareness, roundness, flatness, etc.), temperature measurements, force, torque and strain measurement, Velocity/Speed Measurement, gear measurements, CMM measurement, machine tool metrology.
